preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is a positive integer n within the range [1, 500000].

postconditions.description: The first output line is either 'First' or 'Second', indicating the chosen player role.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'First') == ('2n' in [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()])
postconditions.description: If 'First' is chosen, the second output line contains exactly 2n integers (p_1, ..., p_{2n}) where each p_i is in [1, n], and every integer from 1 to n appears exactly twice in the list.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'Second') == ('n' in [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.strip().split()])
postconditions.description: If 'Second' is chosen, the second output line contains exactly n integers (a_1, ..., a_n) where each a_i is unique and belongs to a distinct pair (i.e., no two a_i's share the same p_i in the input pairs).

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'First') == (all(1 <= int(p) <= n for p in stdout.splitlines()[1].strip().split()) if len(stdout.splitlines()) > 1 else True)
postconditions.description: If 'First' is chosen, the second output line's integers p_i are valid pair indices in [1, n].

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'Second') == (all(1 <= int(a) <= 2*n for a in stdout.splitlines()[1].strip().split()) if len(stdout.splitlines()) > 1 else True)
postconditions.description: If 'Second' is chosen, the second output line's integers a_i are valid numbers in [1, 2n].
If 'Second' is chosen, the second output line's integers a_i are all distinct.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'Second') == (all(any(int(a) == i for a in stdout.splitlines()[1].strip().split()) for i in range(1, 2*n+1)) if len(stdout.splitlines()) > 1 else True)
postconditions.description: If 'Second' is chosen, the second output line's integers a_i cover all numbers from 1 to 2n exactly once (i.e., one from each pair).

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'First') == (all(pairs.count(p) == 2 for p in range(1, n+1)) if (pairs := [int(p) for p in stdout.splitlines()[1].strip().split()]) else True)
postconditions.description: If 'First' is chosen, the second output line's integers p_i form exactly n pairs (each pair index appears exactly twice).
